Priya Singh: noticed a few dark-mode edge cases on Console after the staging refresh — thought I'd drop them here.
Ethan Park: thanks, what did you find?
Priya Singh: main ones: block code copy button nearly invisible, log-severity badges (info/warn/error) rely on subtle hue shifts that vanish in inverted/screenshots, and custom scrollbar thumb is too faint on Mac retina.
Nora Blake: ugh. screenshots?
Priya Singh: https://img.redwood/mock/console-dark-edges.png. CSS vars: `--copy-btn: rgba(255,255,255,0.14)`, `--badge-info: #7fb1ff`, `--badge-warn: #ffcc66`, `--badge-error: #ff7a7a`, `--scroll-thumb: rgba(255,255,255,0.04)`. Copy button fails contrast when hovered over dark code blocks.
Jasper Li: quick thoughts: bump copy button to `--copy-btn: rgba(255,255,255,0.18)` and add `outline: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06)` on focus. That keeps it subtle but keyboard-visible.
Nora Blake: for badges let's not rely purely on color. add an icon/label shorthand (i, !, x) and subtle pattern (diagonal stripes) for prints/grayscale.
Ethan Park: agree. accessibility rule: don't use color as sole conveyance of state. icons + ARIA labels will fix that.
Priya Singh: also scrollbar: we use 4px thumb, 8px track — thumb at 0.04 alpha disappears in screenshots. propose `--scroll-thumb: rgba(255,255,255,0.08)` and increase min-height for touch to 8px on mac.
Jasper Li: thought: what about syntax highlighting variants? users on the Code Explorer requested a low-contrast "paper" mode for long reads. We could add a setting: "Muted syntax" that desaturates accent colors by 30%.
Nora Blake: yes and keep "High-contrast syntax" toggle too. defaults: accessible, user opt-in for muted.
DesignBot: theme-scan v1.9: issues found: copy button contrast borderline (2.9:1), badge reliance on hue only (fail), scrollbar visibility (fail for screenshots). Recommendations: raise copy button to 3.5:1 min, add iconography to badges, set scrollbar thumb alpha >= 0.07 for dark mode.
Priya Singh: ok I'll file a tiny design PR: copy button updates + badge icons + scrollbar alpha. I'll attach before/after images and WCAG numbers. ETA tomorrow AM.
Ethan Park: can we also scope this to embeddable widgets? those inherit theme vars and might break. Add note in PR description.
Jasper Li: tagging frontend for review: @frontend-team. Also add a beta user flag for "Muted syntax" so we can A/B test.
Nora Blake: nice. please tag design when PR is ready and I'll sign off.
Priya Singh: thanks all :sparkles:
